raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded the solution based on misinterpreted death dates. Specifically, it swapped the death dates of Thomas N. Heffron and Victor Schertzinger when analyzing the data. Heffron’s verified death date (1951-05-24) was attributed to Schertzinger, and Schertzinger’s verified death date (1941-10-26) was attributed to Heffron. This resulted in the Planner incorrectly stating that Heffron (director of *The Love Charm*) died earlier, when the actual earlier death was Schertzinger's (director of *The Constant Woman*). The mistake fundamentally stemmed from misassociation of data between entities during the final analytical step.
